concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-platforms-balance-updates-manage-balance-webhook]] — 2026-09-15-captured pilot Configuration API guide for viewing, PATCHing, deactivating and deleting Balance webhook settings; a PATCH must retain wanted conditions, and removing the last one broadens alerts to all target balance changes.
